spec.text: Image 1 is the woman's character model sheet; image 2 is a real photo of the woman's bedroom; image 3 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Morning in the woman's small bedroom in Yonghe, based on image 3 but simplified, tidy and uncluttered: a light wood desk with a few neat items and a white desk lamp, a white coat stand with a blush pink cardigan hanging on it, grey curtains pulled open beside a tall glass balcony door. Through the glass, far away in soft morning haze, Taipei 101 rises above the city. She stands in the middle of the room tying her hair back, ready to go out. Warm morning light. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place from the photos in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques, screens or documents are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
